    print(" bot row3s:",[j for i,j in threes if i==rs[-1]])
    print(" left col3s:",[i for i,j in threes if j==cs[0]])
    print(" right col3s:",[i for i,j in threes if j==cs[-1]])
    # any other 3s

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
raw=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def grab(pat,h_,w_):
    m=re.search(pat,raw); rows=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in raw[m.end():].split('\n')[:h_]]; return rows
mi=re.search(r'Demo pair 1 input \(21x17\):\n',raw); mo=re.search(r'Demo pair 1 output \(21x17\):\n',raw)
din=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in raw[mi.end():].split('\n')[:21]]
dout=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in raw[mo.end():].split('\n')[:21]]
mt=re.search(r'Test input \(29x23\):\n',raw)
tin=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in raw[mt.end():].split('\n')[:29]]

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=0]
    if not pts:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    col=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in pts).most_common(1)[0][0] if pts else bg
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    # perimeter
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        for i in (r0,r1):
            if o[i][j]==bg: o[i][j]=col
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in (c0,c1):
            if o[i][j]==bg: o[i][j]=col
    # interior lines: rows/cols with >=2 interior shape cells
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        n=sum(1 for j in range(c0+1,c1) if g[i][j]==col)
        if n>=2:
            for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                if o[i][j]==bg: o[i][j]=col
    for j in range(c0+1,c1):
        n=sum(1 for i in range(r0+1,r1) if g[i][j]==col)
        if n>=2:
            for i in range(r0,r1+1):
                if o[i][j]==bg: o[i][j]=col
    return o
print("demo match:", transform(din)==dout)

diff=[(i,j,tin[i][j],res[i][j]) for i in range(29) for j in range(23) if tin[i][j]!=res[i][j]]
print("test diffs:",diff)
print(json.dumps(res))
